title: Million Dollar Pie Is the Ten-Minute Dessert That Feels Priceless
text:
1 days ago Million Dollar Pie is a cool, creamy Southern dessert filled with pineapple, coconut, pecans, and bright lemon flavor. Sweetened condensed milk and lemon juice create the rich base, while whipped topping keeps the filling fluffy rather than heavy. Well-drained crushed pineapple adds juicy sweetness, coconut brings chewiness, and chopped pecans provide crunch. Everything is spooned into prepared graham cracker crusts and chilled until firm enough to slice. There is no oven, complicated custard, or special equipment involved—just ten minutes of mixing followed by the difficult task of waiting.
Photo by Jason Griffith The recipe makes two pies, which is useful because one often disappears faster than expected. Serve them at summer gatherings, holidays, potlucks, family dinners, or any occasion when oven space is already claimed. A shortbread crust can replace the graham cracker base, while mandarin oranges or cherries can introduce additional fruit. Drain every canned ingredient thoroughly so the filling sets properly, and chill the pies for several hours before serving. Toasted coconut, whipped cream, or extra pecans make attractive finishing touches. The name may sound extravagant, but the ingredients are familiar and affordable. Its real luxury is having a cold, nostalgic dessert completely prepared before guests walk through the door.
